hints: Fractions, decimals and percents are hard to compare as they are. Change them all to the same form.
Change all of them to decimals. For 2/5, make the bottom 10: 2/5 = 4/10.
2/5 = 0.4, 41% = 0.41 and 3/8 = 0.375. Write each with three digits after the point and compare them with 0.395.

steps.why: To change a percent to a decimal, move the point two places left.
1/8 = 0.125, so 3/8 = 3 × 0.125 = 0.375. This one is worth memorizing.
With three digits after the point, you can compare them like whole numbers: 410, 400, 395, 375.

trapNotes.2/5: 2/5 = 0.400 is close, but 41% = 0.410 is a little bigger. Change everything to decimals before deciding.
trapNotes.0.395: More digits does not mean bigger. 0.395 is less than 0.400 and 0.410.
trapNotes.3/8: 3/8 = 0.375, the smallest of the four. A fraction with bigger numbers in it is not always bigger.
